description: Get one skipper's public profile by ID: experience, bio, licences by name, languages, the boats they skipper and the regions they work in, personality, what they offer on board, their rules, where they sleep, whether meals are included, and photos. With dates, `free` says whether they are free on every day of that stay. `price` is what the guest pays for that skipper, charged on its own and never part of a boat's total: `per_day`, and with dates `total` for the `days` of the stay. It is not the skipper fee a boat lists itself.

currency.description: Optional: the currency every amount in the answer is written in, and any price you send is read in. When the conversation has its own currency, that one is used whatever is sent; otherwise the one sent, EUR when omitted.

date_from.description: Optional check-in date YYYY-MM-DD of the boat stay.

date_to.description: Optional check-out date YYYY-MM-DD of the boat stay.

id.description: Skipper id from search_skippers results — copy it verbatim.

name: get_skipper_details
title: Get Skipper Profile
